candidate_binding.required_execution_state: clean committed descendant of authorization_handoff_commit, preserving accepted_wp3_candidate_commit as an ancestor; the exact WP4 implementation candidate must be recorded before CredentialNative may run

disposable_namespace.raw_target_retention: helper-memory-only; artifacts and receipts retain target_fingerprint_sha256 only
disposable_namespace.reuse: never; each derived target is one qualification target and uncertainty blocks the entire namespace

call_rules: CredWriteW may write only one declared exact target with CRED_TYPE_GENERIC and CRED_PERSIST_LOCAL_MACHINE after its preflight absence check
CredReadW may read only one declared exact target and never returns secret bytes above the helper boundary
CredDeleteW may delete only one declared exact target during its scenario or bounded terminal cleanup
CredFree is called exactly once for every successful CredReadW native allocation and for no other pointer

entry_boundary.control: native masked entry owned by helper
entry_boundary.terminal_behavior: submit returns only non-secret success or typed error; cancel/close/timeout returns only cancelled or typed error and clears mutable entry buffers

required_scenarios.required_result: helper-owned masked entry writes and verifies one runtime-only disposable canary, returns no secret, then cleanup proves absence
cancel/close returns only cancelled, performs no CredWriteW, clears mutable entry state, and cleanup proves absence
2,560-byte encoded generic credential succeeds; 2,561-byte value fails before CredWriteW with no truncation, split, alternate storage, or activation; both targets end absent
typed unavailable state remains non-active, has no fallback, and exact-target cleanup/absence is proved after the bounded fault clears
new generation is written and verified, old generation becomes ineligible before exact deletion, cleanup obligation survives failure/restart, and both targets end absent
revocation epoch closes undispatched use before exact deletion; deleted is recorded only after confirmed absence
faults around write/read/delete retain visible intent and recover by known exact identity without enumeration; terminal cleanup proves absence
backup contains neither secret nor target; restore is recovery-required; restored generation cannot reactivate; local entry creates a new generation; both targets end absent

final generation/revocation/deadline/budget revalidation succeeds, helper reads the exact target, only the deterministic fake provider runs, response is staged before coordinator admission, and cleanup proves absence
injected cleanup failure or ambiguous absence is visible, cannot pass, performs no fallback, and blocks target plus namespace reuse until a fresh owner-authorized cleanup action

backup_restore_recovery.reactivation: local helper entry into a new generation only; restored generation cannot reactivate
backup_restore_recovery.old_target_cleanup: known exact target only; confirmed absence required; no enumeration

canary_contract.secret_canary: runtime-only; never serialized or fingerprinted in an artifact
canary_contract.pass_condition: zero exact secret-canary and raw-target-canary matches on every forbidden surface

cleanup_contract.preflight_collision: if exact-target CredReadW succeeds, stop without write or delete, mark namespace blocked, and require a fresh manifest
cleanup_contract.procedure: bounded exact-target CredDeleteW followed by exact-target CredReadW expecting ERROR_NOT_FOUND; CredFree every successful read allocation
cleanup_contract.absence_proof: per-target target_fingerprint_sha256 plus exact-target ERROR_NOT_FOUND result and zero raw target retention
cleanup_contract.ambiguous_or_failed: fail CredentialNative, retain cleanup-ambiguous or cleanup-failed, block every derived target and namespace reuse, perform no fallback, and require fresh owner authorization before another native mutation
cleanup_contract.reuse_after_absence: not permitted; this manifest is one-shot

required_evidence: exact manifest byte count and SHA-256
exact implementation candidate, accepted WP3 candidate, handoff commit, branch, SDK, helper binary, protocol, schema, and storage fingerprints
canonical non-secret native-call trace naming only allowed calls, target fingerprints, typed results, counts, and CredFree pairing
per-scenario lifecycle, generation, revocation, intent, final-gate, staging, and terminal-state receipts
helper-owned submit and cancel results with no secret or raw target
replacement, revoke/delete, crash/restart, unavailable-store, and cleanup-obligation results
backup bytes/hash, restored recovery-required state, new-generation re-entry, and no-secret/no-target assertions
fake-provider transcript with one dispatch maximum and zero DNS, socket, HTTP, provider, billable, retry, or fallback operations
secret and target canary scan with exact scanned-surface inventory and zero forbidden matches
cleanup attempt and exact-target post-cleanup ERROR_NOT_FOUND evidence for every derived target
blocked-namespace receipt for every injected or actual cleanup ambiguity/failure
process tree, inherited-handle, UI ownership, memory-clearing, crash-containment, and no-survivor evidence
machine-readable CredentialNative receipt plus concise human summary
fresh independent Windows credential/security review bound to exact candidate, manifest, receipt, and cleanup evidence

review_scope: native allocation ownership and CredFree pairing
absence of enumeration, arbitrary-target access, and alternate-store fallback
helper-owned masked entry, cancellation, UI parenting, and non-echo behavior
secret lifetime, mutable-buffer clearing, logging, diagnostics, crash artifacts, and canary coverage
generation, revocation, deadline, budget, staging, backup/restore, and recovery bindings
fake-provider-only dispatch and zero DNS/network/provider/billable effects
terminal-path cleanup, exact-target absence proof, ambiguous cleanup blocking, and no namespace reuse
gate cannot run through ordinary tests, All, NonLiveAll, or any implicit path
retained receipt identities and append-only evidence truthfulness
independent_review.acceptance_rule: WP4 remains unaccepted unless the fresh reviewer returns ACCEPT against the exact implementation candidate, manifest identity, gate receipt, and cleanup evidence

acceptance_binding.method: explicit owner acceptance of exact manifest bytes out-of-band before any WP4 implementation execution or native effect
acceptance_binding.recording: append the exact owner decision and manifest identity to the Slice 6 append-only record without changing current-state until WP4 acceptance
acceptance_binding.expiry_rule: acceptance or execution at/after expires_at_utc is invalid and requires a fresh manifest
acceptance_binding.mutation_rule: any manifest byte change invalidates acceptance and requires owner acceptance of the new SHA-256
